not_visible.H: whether the render, cutting and checking tools ran cleanly, diagrams and paint maps, and any check that should have caught the tiled patterns

summary: The step pictures carry most of the faults: tiled, mirrored textures (lower sky, mountain slope, shore band), hard rectangular edges, and ghosts of later parts (forest and reed reflections, a cabin-shaped blur, reed blades) that persist across many steps. Sizes in the words often disagree with the pictures (sky bottom, mountain size and peak position), and several steps add color their paints can't make (clouds, cream reflection, bright yellow reeds). The words are otherwise clear; the teaching faults are small.
